approval_source.question_set: Host loss on a real host (T5): the power controller's credential, which server it may power-cycle, how often and when

reason: Host loss is built and proven in the CI staging network only (P01_T05_HOST_LOSS_2026-11-09), which left the real hosts' power path (the provider's power API and the credential it needs on the founder's machine) to a later decision. Without it T5 has no real-host evidence for host loss.

decisions.question: P01_T05_HOST_LOSS_2026-11-09, the real hosts' power path: the power controller's credential
decisions.selected: The existing dytallix hcloud context on the founder's Mac; no new token
decisions.rule: The power controller is the hcloud CLI on the founder's machine with the context named on every call (--context dytallix), the context load_machines.py already uses, so the project's token stays in hcloud's own configuration; HCLOUD_* variables are removed from its environment, so an environment token can never pick another project. No new token is made and no token passes through the tool or the repository.

decisions.question: Which server real-host host loss may power-cycle, how often and against what target
decisions.selected: Only the staging sentry (ubuntu-4gb-hel1-2, id 120260174, hel1), once, in a window after the T9 drill (Friday 13 November 2026), against the same 600 s target
decisions.rule: faults.py host-loss powers off hard (hcloud server poweroff) and on again only the server with id 120260174, and only after hcloud reports that id with the name ubuntu-4gb-hel1-2 in location hel1; any other server, the validator (ubuntu-4gb-fsn1-1, id 131186483) and the founder's web server (docker-ce-ubuntu-4gb-ash-1) included, is refused before any power call. It runs once, in a window after the T9 validator host drill of Friday 13 November 2026. After the power-on, the sentry's public status page http://89.167.52.129:8080/status must serve a block made after the power-on within 600 seconds (TIMINGS.json host_loss_target_seconds), or the run fails. Its evidence is the CI drill's record (faults.py build_run), marked as a real-host run by the controller it names.

unset: The run's date and window (after Friday 13 November 2026's T9 drill): not chosen yet; host loss is not run on the real sentry until it is
supersedes: P01_T05_HOST_LOSS_2026-11-09, decision "The real hosts' power path" (CI staging network only for now); its other decisions stand
does_not_authorize: powering off, rebuilding or deleting any server other than id 120260174
more than one real-host host loss run
a run before its window is chosen
a new provider token, or any change to a server's protection
